sources.title: Create AI-summarized email digests from Gmail labels with OpenAI O4 ...
sources.snippet: Each email is processed through OpenAI's language model using LangChain to create concise, readable summaries that preserve important links and formatting. All summaries are then combined into a single, well-formatted digest email and sent to your inbox, replacing dozens of individual emails with one comprehensive overview.
